outcome: Foetal umbilical artery Doppler impedance indices
cohort: 127 pregnant women (53 with PE and 74 controls) from the Obstetrics and Gynaecology Department of the Tamale Teaching Hospital, the Bawku Presbyterian Hospital and the Bolgatanga Regional Hospital
finding: Women with PE had increased risk of adverse foeto-maternal complications, significantly associated with placental mal-perfusion lesions, had reduced platelet concentration and elevated RDW levels, elevated NTPro-BNP, RI and SD, and reduced neuropilin-1 concentration.
mod_finding: Caesarian deliveries were higher in women with PE compared to the non-PE group.
